name: Pont Royal
locality: 1st arrondissement of Paris; 7th arrondissement of Paris; Saint-Germain-l'Auxerrois; Saint-Thomas-d'Aquin
text: The Pont Royal is a bridge crossing the river Seine in Paris. It is the third oldest bridge in Paris, after the Pont Neuf and the Pont Marie.

depictions.name: Pont Royal
depictions.text: The Pont Royal is a bridge crossing the Seine in Paris, France. The Pont Royal is one of the oldest bridges in Paris, and was built in 1632 as a toll bridge to replace a ferry. Due to its red coloring, it was commonly known as the Pont Rouge, sharing the name with a smaller bridge that linked the city's two islands.
